name: Kuriyama Renge
source: She's the childhood friend of the protagonist and his neighbor. A close friend of the Inami siblings since their childhood. A single-minded, headstrong, devoted girl who often finds herself at a loss due to her character. Actually, she was the lover of Shuu, but right now she's his ex-girlfriend. Apparently they have  a lot of reasons for it…….
